assignments.essential_function: Explore supplied customer cohorts through retention/adoption summaries, curves and heatmaps, then suggest research to explain patterns.

review: Read complete unchanged SKILL.md. Provides a compact, specific supplied-data workflow: validate cohort structure, summarize retention/adoption, plot heatmaps and curves, compare patterns, and propose qualitative follow-up. Selected for descriptive cohort exploration, where omissions are stated scope limits; it is not sold as a complete statistical retention engine. No mathematical formula or causal claim in this skill needed correction. The guide is thinner than the Anthropic profiling/visualization references and no independent efficacy benchmark was found.
native_prerequisites: CSV/Excel/JSON or SQL-result reading; user supplies defined cohorts, time periods and engagement metrics.
Python pandas/numpy and charting runtime when code/charts are requested.
Further-reading article links are optional, not bundled article content or mandatory executable dependencies.
